The SSH command to clone Super_Awesome_Robot is:

```
ssh://git@172.26.116.102:2223/convexegg/super_awesome_robot.git
```

To clone the repository, use:
```bash
git clone ssh://git@172.26.116.102:2223/convexegg/super_awesome_robot.git
```

Note: You need to have SSH keys configured in your GitLab profile to use this SSH clone command. If you haven't added an SSH key yet, you can add one by clicking 'Add SSH key' on the project page.
